method.cold: Fresh process, first recognition; OS/framework file caches are not flushed.
method.warm: One excluded warmup per fixture; alternating engine order, persistent workers. Wall time includes image decoding, inference, JSON and IPC; excludes Swift compilation and document parsing.
method.quality: NFKC, case-folded, whitespace/punctuation/symbol-stripped Levenshtein CER. Synthetic fixtures only; punctuation and case errors are hidden by this metric.
method.transparency: Prepared variant uses the same white-compositing rule as the WASM core; generation is outside timing.
